name: VANUATU

flag.title: Flag of Vanuatu
flag.note: Green, red, black with yellow boar's tusk

lead: Vanuatu is 83 volcanic islands in the South Pacific. Under 340,000 people live here, and they speak 138 languages. You can walk right up to a volcano that still erupts. One tribe once worshipped a British prince.

sections.wows: 7 things to make you go wow

geo: Vanuatu sits on the Pacific Ring of Fire, where giant plates of rock push up volcanoes. The islands stretch 1,300 km. The biggest, Espiritu Santo, has the highest peak, Mt Tabwemasana, at 1,877 m.
Rainforest covers the hills. Coral gardens grow under the sea. The SS President Coolidge, a ship sunk in 1942, is a famous dive site.
animals: The coconut crab is Earth's largest land crab. Its claws can crack coconuts and bend steel. Vanuatu's own flying fox (a fruit bat) spreads pollen at night.
Seven bird species live nowhere else on Earth. Dugongs (sea cows) graze on sea grass in calm bays. Bright parrotfish crunch coral on every reef.
culture: In Bislama, the local language, kastom means traditional culture. Each village has its own kind. Every evening, people share kava (a drink from pepper plant root) at a nakamal, or kava bar.
Bislama, English and French are the official languages. Ceremonies mix costumes, chiefs' ranks and drumming. Weaving, wood carving and sand drawing pass from grandparent to child.
history: Melanesian (Pacific island) people settled these islands about 3,000 years ago. In 1906, Britain and France ran the New Hebrides Condominium together: two governments, two police forces, two prisons.
Vanuatu became independent on 30 July 1980. Its name means 'our land stands forever'.
wows: Vanuatu has more languages per person than any country.
The Mt Yasur volcano on Tanna has erupted almost non-stop for centuries.
Pentecost Island's tower jump, with vines on the ankles, inspired bungee jumping.
Vanuatu ranked No. 1 on the Happy Planet Index (happiest places) in 2006 and 2024.
A tribe on Tanna once worshipped Prince Philip, the queen's husband, as a god.
Vanuatu has no tax on pay, company profits or gains from selling things.
The coconut crab, the largest land crab, weighs up to 4 kg.

myths.fact: Bislama is a full language. Its words come from English, French and local tongues.

myths.myth: The Pentecost tower jump is just a tourist show
myths.fact: It is a ceremony for the yam harvest. It is held each year between April and June.
